A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CausalDPO study and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–B. The complete material supports reliable comparison; the appendices are identical in text and rendering.

before.justification: v1 reports original recommendation experiments on Yelp2018, ML-10M, and Book-Crossing, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, runtime measurements, and sensitivity analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Table 1, Figures 1–3, and Appendix B, including the supplementary comparisons and ablations.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same procedure: DBSCAN-based environment discovery, soft assignments, backdoor adjustment, and a DPO objective with MMD regularization. No method component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three datasets and the same popularity, temporal, exposure, and mixed distribution shifts, alongside IID evaluation. Appendix B.1's coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and supplementary experiments, including the eight main baselines and the DPO, CPO, SimPO, and Dr.DPO comparisons. The newly cited related works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Sections 3.6 and B.1–B.3 retain identical preprocessing, splits, HR/NDCG evaluation at 10 and 20, training budgets, negative sampling, and model configurations. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The SFT/alignment ablations, causal-regularization comparisons, backbone analysis, clustering visualizations, and hyperparameter sweeps remain unchanged in Tables 5–9 and Figures 2–3. No robustness or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed/run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. The same point-estimate reporting is retained throughout the empirical results.

E6.justification: Reported scores, runtimes, rankings, plotted trends, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports CausalDPO's Yelp2018 HR@10 as 1.53% and NDCG@10 as 0.77% in both versions; the abstract's 17.17% improvement claim is also retained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, Propositions 3.1–3.3, and Appendix A's derivations and proofs are identical. No assumptions, bounds, or mathematical reasoning are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about DPO amplifying environmental confounding and CausalDPO improving OOD recommendation through causal invariance. The conclusion's final line moves pages without changing meaning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of clustering, imperfect environment recovery, IID behavior, computational tradeoffs, and sensitivity results remain unchanged in Sections 3.4–3.9 and Appendix B. The impact statement's content is also unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware specifications, runtime information, and the code-access statement are unchanged. The new acknowledgement names the National Supercomputer Center in Guangzhou as providing computational support but adds no technical configuration or reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: Section 4 adds five references: LLM-ESR, LLMEmb, a survey of LLM-enhanced recommendation, and two Dang et al. papers on tail-aware and test-time augmentation. These supplement existing citation lists without substantively changing the research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds acknowledgements, adds Jianzhe Zhao as a correspondence contact, replaces the preprint notice with ICML/PMLR publication information, and changes 'Impact Statements' to 'Impact Statement.' Scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged apart from citation insertions.

P2.justification: The expanded first-page footer shifts the abstract placement, while added citations and acknowledgements reflow related work, the conclusion, and references. Figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly expands bibliographic and acknowledgement coverage and updates publication/contact details. The new references enter existing citation lists without substantive comparison or analysis; scientific evidence, reasoning, and reproducibility guidance remain unchanged. These limited updates do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
